title: New Friends at the Evening Class
instructions: 这是为A0初学者设计的原创模拟阅读材料（非官方考试）。先阅读短文，注意人称代词 I / you 和 be 动词 am / are 的用法，以及句首大写和句号。然后完成8道阅读题和8道语法题。所有题目均为英文，解释为中文。请按题目要求作答。
passage:
A. It is 7 p.m. Anna is at the community center. She is a new student. The class is small. Six people are in the room.

B. A man says, "Hello. I am Ben. Are you a student here?" Anna says, "Yes, I am. I am new. You are Ben?" Ben says, "Yes, I am. We are classmates now." Anna smiles. "Nice to meet you."

C. A woman says, "Hi, I am Ms. Lee. I am the teacher. You are early. Good!" Anna says, "Thank you. I am happy." Ms. Lee says, "We are a team. You are welcome here."

questions.explanation: 短文第一句说“It is 7 p.m.”，所以时间是晚上7点。
短文说“Anna is at the community center.”，所以她在社区中心。
questions.evidence: Anna is at the community center.

questions.prompt: How many people are in the room?
questions.explanation: 短文说“Six people are in the room.”，所以房间里有六个人。
questions.evidence: Six people are in the room.

questions.explanation: Ben 说“We are classmates now.”，说明 Ben 也是新同学。
Ms. Lee 说“I am the teacher.”，所以她是老师。

questions.prompt: How does Anna feel after speaking to Ms. Lee? Complete her sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: "I am ____."
questions.explanation: Anna 说“I am happy.”，所以填 happy。

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: Ms. Lee says, "You are ____."
questions.explanation: Ms. Lee 说“You are early.”，所以填 early。

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Lee say about the class?
questions.explanation: Ms. Lee 说“We are a team.”，所以选“We are a team.”。

grammar.title: 人称代词 I / you 与 be 动词 am / are
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，I 表示“我”，是第一人称单数；you 表示“你”，是第二人称单数。be 动词 am 只和 I 连用（I am）；are 和 you 连用（you are）。句子开头第一个字母要大写，句子结尾要加句号。例如：I am Anna. You are Ben.
grammar.example: I am Ben. Are you a student here?

questions.explanation: 句首字母 I 要大写，句尾要有句号，所以“I am a student.”正确。
句首字母 Y 要大写，句尾要有句号，所以“You are new.”正确。
I 是第一人称单数，后面用 am，所以是“I am happy.”。
You 是第二人称单数，后面用 are，所以是“You are early.”。
问“你是学生吗？”用“Are you a student?”，you 与 are 连用，句首大写，句尾问号。
否定句在 am 后加 not，所以“I am not late.”正确。

questions.prompt: Write the missing word: ____ are a teacher.
questions.explanation: 句首需要大写 You，构成“You are a teacher.”。

questions.prompt: Write the missing word: I ____ new.
questions.explanation: I 是第一人称单数，后面用 am，所以填 am。
